token.name: Harrowquay Real Estate Fund (demo), Class X
token.description: Fictional testnet demo: tokenised share class of an evergreen real-estate fund. Units issued at NAV each dealing day to the manager's dealing desk, which sells them on the same day. No real fund, property, investor or offer.
